name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global manufacturing PMI 52.6 in October; composite at its highest since 2021 in September
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Manufacturing PMI eased to 52.6 in October from 53.0, still well above 50 (S&P Global, 2 Nov). The global composite reached its joint-highest level since 2021 in September, with expansion across all sectors (S&P Global, 6 Oct). The October composite, due on 4 Nov, had not been found as of this check.
for_you: Global activity is still expanding, which supports trade and jobs. Rising input costs are the main pressure on firms.
